legend: n system name; l label; t type (sel choice, text one line, area plain multi-line, html rich text, code CSS/HTML code, embed link or raw embed code, color, font, icon Font Awesome class, img image path set by the file manager, ids comma-separated ids, hidden no visible field); o options [value, wording, {addon, kind, pt, defId, show}] or @name of a list in sets; r [min, max, step] with unit; d value the admin shows and saves when the setting is empty; dfrom the admin fills an empty value from that other setting; dnew / dnewfrom the same two, but only while the setting has never been saved (no row at all): an empty stored value does not get them; max form length limit only; addon add-on that must be active (a,b = all, a|b = any); site options come from this site (post_types:single|multi|digital, plans, sidebars, top_categories, sub_categories, menus:filter); show = when the admin shows the field (hidden fields are still saved); used = when the front end reads it; both are lists of clauses that must all hold: [name, op, value] with op =, !=, in, not_in, kind, not_kind (family of the chosen custom_30 option), pt (post-type kind of the chosen custom_30 option); ["site:widget", "absent_or_contains", [W, text]] holds when the site has no customised copy of widget W or its copy contains text; ["any", [clauses]] holds when one does; ["rows", "has", W] holds while any of the 15 homepage rows holds W; a name starting site:, addon: or visitor is a fact about the site or visitor, not a design setting; who = which visitors; h help text; note a trap in plain words; refuse true = a settings write must never take this name; through = part of a group that is only ever written together, never one setting at a time (rows: one homepage row; hero: the hero type with its category settings). In a block: rows = the 15 names {row} stands for, N = the range {N} stands for; in clauses {row} and {N} mean the same row. Values starting HS:, D: or HP: are shortened with pre. color_set_fields = the settings a colour set overwrites in the admin form. Colour fields save rgb(R, G, B); post_image_bg_color may hold rgba(R, G, B, A). used is advisory: a tool may say "no visible effect while ..." and never refuses a write because of it. A used rule never excludes a case where some visitor sees the setting; where that could not be written exactly there is no rule and a note says what it depends on. A clause on a fact that is not known (add-on status, site:, visitor) gives "cannot tell", and for used "cannot tell" counts as used. In clauses an empty stored value is read as the field's d.
